tracking.notes: Untracked frees may release valid pre-epoch storage. Requested heap excludes Python arena suballocations, mmap and nonintercepted allocators.

lifetime: input owners + runner/plan/prepared + cold + 5warm + two independent complete result generations
measurement_scope: continuous requested heap includes full inputs/setup/cold/5warm/replacements; stage peaks overlap and must not be added
input construction uses frozen deterministic RNG only to create fixed replay fixtures, not the platform random stream
pre-execution input fingerprints and NativeRunner's own hashes are part of setup; large output parity/hashing are after the epoch
NJIT copies the full immutable logical raw tape inside execution; original platform RNG-owned tape does not pay that replay copy
native borrows exact readonly input views, owns all stream/scale scratch, and returns independent typed roots plus compact egress
RSS baseline precedes full input/owner construction; warmed 0.5ms sampling and idle control do not prove exact allocator coverage
RSS stage values are observed current pages, not per-stage peak/workspace counters; idle control is not subtracted
heap excludes Python arena suballocations/mmap/nonintercepted allocators; no complete-RSS or whole-platform closure claim
each metric uses a fresh PID and one effective native/NJIT/library core; no worker-process shared-page aggregation
